works.alt: Life-size painting of an urban scene in Paris. A man in a top hat holding an umbrella and a woman in a long fashionable dark dress walk arm in arm toward the viewer as other city dwellers with umbrellas walk in various directions across cobblestone roads and sidewalks.

works.t: Acrobats at the Cirque Fernando (Francisca and Angelina Wartenberg)
works.alt: Two girls in acrobatic uniforms stand in an arena, one holds oranges.
Impressionist painting of two girls on balcony, bright flower hat, knitting basket.

Painted portrait dominated by loose, large brushstrokes of a woman, seen from the back, wearing a gauzy white off-the-shoulder dress and black choker, blond hair swept up, examining herself in a mirror at left. The background is a feathered swirl suggesting floral pattern in cool pale tones of gray, purple, pink, and blue.
A young woman in a dark hat and coat with light ruffled collar sits reading a large periodical held up in her gloved hands. Flowers and foliage are suggested behind her.

works.t: On the Bank of the Seine, Bennecourt
works.alt: Painting of woman in a striped dress seated on the bank of a river, beneath a full, leafy tree, a boat at the shore and a village visible across the river.
Painting of a light-skinned woman dressed in a gauzy white gown with black trim playing an upright paino.
Vivid, lush view of rolling waves in purple, white, blue, and green against a bright blue sky with a watercolor-like blending of blues and purples. Sea and sky nearly become one.
Apples and grapes rest in a shallow wicker basket on a table covered with a light-colored cloth. Additional fruit is scattered on the table.
Among potted flowers and lush foliage, a tiny child in a white dress plays with a hoop. A woman peers at the child from an ivy-covered building at right.

A white severed calf's head is suspended from a hook in its nose at right, painted with blue undertones and pink and yellow highlights. At left is a severed ox tongue and mouth rendered in soft white, pinks, and reds, all against a blue-gray background.

works.t: The Seine at Port-Marly, Piles of Sand

works.alt: Orange, yellow, and white flowers in a brown vase on a round table, with a blue-green floral tablecloth and mottled, brownish background. Each perceived main color is made up of strokes of bright, vibrant colors—reds, blues, pinks, and purples—lending dimension to the scene.

works.t: The Arcueil Aqueduct at Sceaux Railroad Crossing

works.alt: Painted portrait of a seated young light-skinned girl with brown hair in a gauzy white dress and hat, eyes downcast, holding a basket.

works.t: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884
works.alt: Large painting of people in a crowded park, brushstrokes are dots.

works.t: The Departure of the Boats, Étretat

works.alt: Painting of a cliff overlooking the sea. Two figures in long dresses, one with a parasol, stand on the cliff beneath blue sky.

works.t: Boats on the Beach at Étretat

works.alt: Bright landscape painting featuring spindly trees with lush leaves surrounded by light-green foliage, a small town visible between the trees at center, and a calm blue sea in the background.

works.t: Oil Sketch for "A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884"
works.alt: Heavy daubs of pigment form a crowded scene of roughly defined, finely dressed individuals in a brightly color park along a riverbank.
Painting of bedroom, blue walls, green window, tan bed, red bedding.
Painting of four women with blue shawls walking near red fence.

works.m: Oil on artist's board, mounted on cradled panel
works.alt: Painting of a red-haired, bearded man with light skin, painted in short brushstrokes and multicolored dots. The background is likewise a mass of small, closely spaced colored dots, these in green, blue, and red-orange.

works.t: Madame Roulin Rocking the Cradle (La berceuse)

works.alt: Painting of three male figures, two older men in top hats and a younger man with red hair, standing outdoors around a wooden table with a pitcher on it, drinking from glasses. A much smaller, childlike figure at left peers over the table and drinks from a white cup. The scene is rendered in winding paint strokes in shades of green and blue.

works.t: Still Life: Wood Tankard and Metal Pitcher
Fishing in Spring, the Pont de Clichy (Asnières)
works.alt: Painting in short strokes of pale blue, green, white, yellow, and pink, of a fisherman in one of two small boats on a river, a tree-lined bank and a bridge in the background.

works.t: Terrace and Observation Deck at the Moulin de Blute-Fin, Montmartre
works.m: Oil on canvas, mounted on pressboard

works.t: A Peasant Woman Digging in Front of Her Cottage
works.alt: Painting in tones of gray and brown, with some green and blue, of a woman digging with a garden tool before a structure with a thatched roof that descends almost to the ground. Above her the sky is gray and blue, a haze of clouds.
Painting of a pond seen up close spotted with thickly painted pink and white water lilies and a shadow across the top third of the picture.
Painting composed of short, dense brushstrokes depicts two domed stacks of wheat that cast long shadows on a field. The angled light indicates either a rising or setting sun.
Painting of a small pond dense with pink water lilies, their roots visible through the water, a railed footbridge arching over the pond and lush, dark green folliage surrounding it.

works.t: Branch of the Seine near Giverny (Mist)
works.alt: Painting of softly rendered shapes in pale blue, green, and white. A textured green mass at left resembles foliage. Blue and white cloud-like forms fill the rest of the frame.

works.t: Stacks of Wheat (End of Day, Autumn)
works.alt: Painting mostly in soft yellow, green, purple, blue, and pink of two wheatstacks, the right nearer than the left, in a country landscape at sunset.

Horizontal oil painting in shades of pale purple, pink, and light blue of a bridge composed of multiple linked archways over water, engulfed in hazy fog. Various indistinct, colorful forms cross the bridge, and factory smokestacks rise in the distance.
Two haystacks, dusted with snow, in a hazy, snow-covered field at sunset. The snow is highlighted in purple tones, the sky a yellow and orange gradient.

works.t: Stack of Wheat (Snow Effect, Overcast Day)
works.alt: A lone wheat stack, in shadow, rests on a snow-covered field that is rendered in shades of white, blue, yellow, and purple. A house can be seen in the distance on the right against the blue hills beyond.
A snowy landscape in cool tones featuring a prominent, snow-dusted haystack in reddish brown in front of a row of red-brown trees and low, blue mountains, all beheath a pink-gray strip of sky.

A lone wheat stack, in shadow, rests on a field with traces of snow, the snow taking on reflected shades of pink, yellow, orange, and blue from the unseen setting sun. A line of pale yellow illuminates the horizon above the hills beyond.

works.t: The Bay of Marseille, Seen from L'Estaque
works.alt: Impressionist sea landscape, tan houses, blue ocean, distant mountains.
Painting of a basket of green and red-yellow apples spilling over into a white cloth placed on a wooden table, with a dark green bottle and a plate of pale biscuits behind.

works.t: Madame Cezanne in a Yellow Chair
works.alt: Painting of a placid-looking, light-skinned woman in a maroon dress, seated in a chair with yellow upholstery, hands folded.

works.t: Woman Bathing Her Feet in a Brook
works.alt: Small dots of soft color form a woman in a red shirt and brown skirt seen up close, washing her bare feet in a lush brook while seated on a sloping bank.

View of a village surrounded by hills, fields, and trees, shown from a vantage point above the scene. Subtly rolling hills recede into a bluish gray-ish sky punctuated by white clouds. Thick brushstrokes built up atop each other are visible throughout.

works.t: Standing Bather, Seen from the Back

works.alt: Painting of the Virgin Mary ascending to heaven amongst multitude of angels.

works.t: Salome with the Head of Saint John the Baptist
works.alt: Large painting of woman, in gold and pink dress, placing severed head on platter.
Large painting of cupid being whipped, a woman tries to hold back the a man in red dress.
Still life painting of dead waterfowl and vegetables in windowsill.

Saint John the Baptist in the Wilderness
Margaret of Austria, Queen of Spain
St. Gerardo Sagredo, Bishop of Csanád
Landscape with the Ruins of the Castle of Egmond
works.alt: Dark moody painting of crumbling castle tower and walls amidst river and forest.

works.t: The Watermill with the Great Red Roof
works.alt: Landscape painting featuring a wavy tree tree in the foreground and a watermill with a red roof adjacent to a river at right. Colors are subdued earth tones, the foliage a dark green and the river a muddy brown. Water flows through the mill wheel under a cloudy sky of gray and blue. Three individuals can be seen in the distance at left.

works.t: Old Man with a Gold Chain
works.alt: Portrait of man wearing voluminous black cloak, feathered hat, and gold medallion.

works.t: Two Cows and a Young Bull beside a Fence in a Meadow
works.alt: A tired-looking brown and white cow lies down on a patch of dry earth, a dark-brown bull and cow standing behind her against an overcast sky.

works.t: The Battle between the Gods and the Giants
works.alt: Animated scene of many mostly nude figures in close combat, on earth and aloft in low-hanging clouds, reaching toward one another with long spears.

works.t: Young Woman at an Open Half-Door
works.alt: A young woman peers out to the right from from a Dutch door whose bottom half is closed. She wears a brown dress with a corset and a red beaded necklace.
Painting of a resting man and woman with assorted livestock, arched ruins and a lush landscape behind them.

works.t: A Boy Blowing on a Firebrand
Interior of the Oude Kerk, Delft
A View of Vianen with a Herdsman and Cattle by a River
Pastoral Scene with a Shepherdess Milking a Goat
Fishing Boats with Hucksters Bargaining for Fish
works.alt: Large marine landscape of boats on rough waves, storm clouds.
Large English country landscape painting, farmers with horses, green trees.
A light-skinned woman in a long, shiny white dress sits at a desk reading a book. The book is propped on a large red pillow. Her head is propped in her hand.
Painting of a dark-skinned man seated and wearing a red open-necked tunic. He looks up to the right. His wrists are shackled and a large chain rests at his right, running down the bench he sits upon.
Portrait of white man dressed in all black with medallion and sword.

works.t: The Combat of the Giaour and Hassan
works.alt: Two men on horseback clash in battle, another man crouches with knife.

works.alt: Painting of two fishermen in small wooden boat on rocky seas.

works.t: Elizabeth Grant Bankson Beatty (Mrs. James Beatty) and Her Daughter Susan
works.alt: Portrait of a light-skinned woman with dark curly hair and to her right a small, blond child. Both are elegantly dressed, the woman in a dark, short-sleeved dress with gathered bodice and the child in a short-sleeved white dress. A white tassel hangs down above the child from a nearby curtain.
Ecuadorian landscape with people, palm trees, waterfall, and volcano in background.
Painting of a vast autumn scene with two very small figures in Indigenous clothing standing on a cliff overlooking a massive waterfall in the distance.
Still life painting of strawberries, nuts, lemon, and porcelain vessels.
Small painting of woman in pink and black sitting on park bench.

Highly detailed painting in mostly earth tones of a forested area that opens up at a small path to frame on all sides a light-blue body of water an a small sailboat, rolling mountains in the distance.

works.t: The Two Disciples at the Tomb
The Fountain, Villa Torlonia, Frascati, Italy
works.alt: Portrait of a woman in white with a bonnet perched on an architectural feature painting something to her right, a spouting water fountain, greenery, and a an ornate, low white fence behind her. Beside her, a man leans back, eying the canvas.
Painting of four figures in blue, red, brown dresses playing croquet.

works.t: Rehearsal of the Pasdeloup Orchestra at the Cirque d'Hiver
At the River's Bend (On the River II)
Retable and Frontal of the Life of Christ and the Virgin

works.alt: Dense and varied landscape with open fields, groves of bushy trees, and a row of thin conifers. A light-blue river tranverses the canvas, and a church steeple emerges from the trees at left of center. At far left is a side view of a white house with open shutters, a woman working inside.

works.t: Still Life with Dead Game, Fruits, and Vegetables in a Market
works.alt: An older man at left in red raises his hat toward a central table chaotically overflowing with dead game, fruits, and vegetables. The wings of dead birds and limbs of animals are splayed out at dramatic angles; a deer at center is suspended by his back legs. Live birds and a cat animate the scene.
Large painting of ancient arch ruins, statues, humans are small in comparison.
Large painting of soldier asleep outdoors surrounded by two women and a cupid.

works.t: Lady Sarah Bunbury Sacrificing to the Graces
works.alt: Large painting, woman in pink dress in front of classical sculpture, shrine.

works.t: Rinaldo and Armida in Her Garden

works.alt: Large, dark painting of Jesus sitting with three standing soldiers.

Painting depicting the god Hercules confronting the Hydra, a mythical creature. Amidst towering, rocky cliffs, Hercules stands on the left of the painting, dressed in clothing that exposes his figure. He looks to the right, where the seven-headed hydra rears up, bearing its teeth. A nude figure of a woman is on the ground in front of the Hydra, and an orange sun peeks from behind red clouds in the background.

A light-skinned woman, the bodice of her mauve dress pulled down, lounges against a rock, her arm extended on it. A child, mostly nude, stands in front of her looking downward while two men in her party, largely in shadow, lean toward each other as if in conversation.
Painting of a lively wedding reception with a man in red kneeling in front of a table. The wedding party is dressed in pale pink clothes and seated.
A man with sparse brown facial hair stands in a full-length black robe on a multicolored tiled floor, a white and brown dog behind him.

works.t: Virgin and Child with Saints Dominic and Hyacinth
Triptych of the Virgin and Child with Saints

works.alt: St. George on white horse, piercing green, gold dragon

works.t: Rinaldo and the Magus of Ascalon
Theodosius Repulsed from the Church by Saint Ambrose
Portrait of a Noblewoman Dressed in Mourning

works.alt: A light-skinned nude woman, center, struggles while a light-skinned nude man, top left, violently pulls white translucent fabric off of her. Dark red and brown textiles, a pillow, dagger, and fallen nude statue complete the scene.

works.a: Workshop of Diego Rodriguez de Velázquez

works.t: A1: Massachusetts Living Room and Kitchen, 1675–1700
works.alt: Miniature of a cozy living room and kitchen in rich maple-colored wood tones, hardwood floors and wood paneling on the walls, a large brick fireplace and stove on the right. A cupboard on the back wall contains silver plates and mugs.
Miniature parlor with low ceilings, hardwood floors, fireplace, and back wall with cherry-colored wood paneling. Room is full with mismatched, upholstered wooden furniture.
Miniature dining room with yellow painted and white wood-paneled walls, rustic wooden furniture, dark wood floors.

works.t: A4: Connecticut Valley Tavern Parlor, c. 1750
works.alt: Miniature drawing room with wooden chimney and shelves, rustic furniture, woven carpet in the middle.
Miniature dining room with wallpaper of a mythological-like landscape, with white shelves and wooden appliances, dark wooden furniture, orange-toned fabric.
Miniature upper-class room with front door, dark wood floors, spiral staircase, and white walls with wooden decorations.
Miniature upper-class room with white wood-paneled walls, chandelier, wooden furniture, and canopied bed and curtains draped with matching printed fabrics.
Miniature room with light green walls, wallpaper of a classic ancient landscape, chimney with the portrait of an old man hanging on top, two windows, and wooden furniture.

Miniature dining room with mint-green walls and two large windows on the back wall, between which hangs a portrait of a Revolutionary-era man flanked by two vases. A formal wooden table with two chairs sits in the room's center, a fireplace with a mirror on the mantle and two tall stools at left.
Miniature scale model of a large, furnished white-walled room with ornamental moulding, wooden flooring, upholstered wooden chairs, and a large decorative carpet in the floor's center.
A miniature room with yellow walls, inset pillars, and an ornate cabinet centered on the far wall. At room's center, a large chandelier hangs over a small table with two upholstered chairs.

Scale miniature of a rustic but refined kitchen with a varnished wooden table at center and one chair. A dark wooden chest sits beneath the window at left, a spinning wheel in the left back corner. In the right corner is an ornately carved door adjacent to a staircase. Metal plates line a wide hearth.

Miniature room featuring wide-plank hardwood floors, round hooked rugs, simple wooden furnishings, and a wood-burning stove. The window frames and door frames are painted green, while the walls are a light butter yellow.
Miniature dining room with dark wood floors, dark wooden furniture, walls decorated with floral paintings.
Miniature aristocratic home sitting room beige paneled walls; chandelier; and wooden, upholstered furniture.
Miniature dining room with white walls and ceiling, wooden floor, dark wood chairs and table with rose-colored fabric.
Miniature upper-class room, with dark wood floors, marble fireplace, and walls covered in decorative, light blue paneling. The room contains wooden furniture, upholstered chairs, and a large rug.
Miniature version of a large entryway in a stately home, with front door open, dark wood floors, wood-paneled walls with portraiture, a floral rug, and wooden furniture.
Miniature drawing room with wood-paneled walls, chandelier, carpet in the center, desk, chimney, and concave mirror.
Miniature room with dark wood floors, white wood-paneled walls, blue curtains, colonial furniture.
Miniature parlor with two rooms divided by a wall opening. There is a large chandelier, gold-gilded frames and mirrors, and red and yellow upholstered wooden furniture.
Miniature room featuring walls decorated with a tropical landscape, a spiral staircase, a crystal chandelier, and two rugs.
Miniature parlor room with green walls, carpeted floor, gothic-like window, and wooden furniture.
Bright miniature living room with white walls and ceiling, wooden floors, large windows, double doors, and minimal furniture.

works.t: E1: English Great Room of the Late Tudor Period, 1550–1603
works.alt: To-scale great room with a double-height ceiling. The bottom half of each wall is clad in elaborately carved wooden panels. The right wall features a tall bay window, the left a fireplace flanked by suits of armor. A long, rustic table with bench is centered in the room.

works.t: E2: English Bedchamber of the Jacobean or Stuart Period, 1603–88
E3: English Reception Room of the Jacobean/Caroline Periods, 1625–55
works.alt: Miniature of an ornate room with red walls and white and gold trim, a large fireplace at center, and black and white checkered flooring. Two armchairs flank a window on the left side. Three large painted portraits in golden frames hang on the back wall. There is a small table directly in front of the fireplace.

works.t: E4: English Drawing Room of the Late Stuart Period, 1680–1702
works.alt: Miniature aristocratic room with dark wood floors, darker wood-paneled walls, upholstered furniture, and marble fireplace.

works.t: E5: English Cottage Kitchen of the Queen Anne Period, 1702–14
E6: English Library of the Queen Anne/George I Periods, 1702–50
E7: English Drawing Room of the Early Georgian Period, 1730s
E8: English Bedroom of the Georgian Period, 1760–75
E9: English Drawing Room of the Georgian Period, 1770–1800
works.alt: Miniature room with cream-colored walls with inset columns on the side walls and two columns at the back framing a dark wooden bookshelf. A large crystal chandelier hangs from a curved ceiling patterned with geometric designs in relief. A beige floral rug fills the floor, upon which a yellow couch and other upholstered wood furniture are unevenly spaced. On the right wall is an ornate fireplace with a mantle framing a painting of a landscape.

works.t: E10: English Dining Room of the Georgian Period, 1770–90
works.alt: Miniature Georgian-era dining room with pale green walls, ornate white trim, long glass table.

works.t: E11: English Entrance Hall of the Georgian Period, c. 1775
E12: English Drawing Room of the Georgian Period, c. 1800
E13: English Rotunda and Library of the Regency Period, 1810–20
E14: English Drawing Room of the Victorian Period, 1840–70
E16: French Hall of the Louis XII Period, c. 1500
E17: French Bedroom of the Henri IV Period, Late 16th Century
works.alt: Miniature of a very dark, ornate bedroom with a partially canopied green bed at center, brown parquet flooring, and deep brown and golden wallpaper. A gold chandelier hangs in the center, and two dark-brown cupboards sit on either side of the room. On the right is also a white and brown fireplace.

works.t: E18: French Salon of the Louis XIV Period, 1660–1700
E19: French Dining Room of the Louis XIV Period, 1660–1700
E20: French Library of the Louis XV Period, c. 1720
works.alt: Miniature aristocratic home library with wood-paneled walls, floral carpet, and ornate and upholstered furniture.

works.t: E21: French Boudoir of the Louis XV Period, 1740–60
works.alt: Ornate interior with cream walls and dark wood floors. At left is a large window with blue curtains; at right is a fireplace with tall mirror. Gilded upholstered furniture and decorative elements, including numerous framed portraits, fill the room. A crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling.

works.t: E22: French Provincial Bedroom of the Louis XV Period, 18th Century
E23: French Dining Room of the Louis XV/Louis XVI Periods, 1760–80
works.alt: Miniature dining room with light gray walls, elaborate decorative molding, gold and glass chandelier, and gold gilt furniture.

works.t: E24: French Salon of the Louis XVI Period, c. 1780
E25: French Bathroom and Boudoir of the Revolutionary Period, 1793–1804
works.alt: Miniature model of a large, stately room with a circular marble tub sunk into the floor's center and fireplace at right. A central archway reveals a sitting area beyond.

works.t: E26: French Anteroom of the Empire Period, c. 1810
works.alt: Miniature room with two green chairs, bronze sculpture, harp, and walls decorated in dark marble and gold accents.

works.t: E28: German Sitting Room of the Biedermeier Period, 1815–50
works.alt: Replica of a sitting room with pale-blue walls and a wave-patterned wallpaper border. Heavy red velvet curtains on the center wall frame two tall windows, between which hangs a painting of a woman in a gold frame. A beige stone fireplace is at left, an open arched doorway at right.

works.t: E29: English Roman Catholic Church in the Gothic Style, 1275–1300
